data.verdict: Explicit seminormal→Young Tits deformation for (4,1). T(q₀)=diag(√(g_i(1)/g_i(q₀))) is (i) a valid *-COMPATIBLE Tits conjugator — exact *-isometry Tᵀ·G(q₀)·T=G(1) (resid 1.42e-71), conjugate self-adjoint w.r.t. G(1) (resid 8.15e-71), and →Id as q→1 (|T−Id|=3.18e-9 at the q-step); so φ=ρ_S⁻¹∘conj(T)∘ρ_H is a *-algebra iso H₅(q₀)→ℂ[S₅] on the block. (ii) It is NOT a generator-intertwiner: T·ρ_H^{q₀}·T⁻¹ keeps the Hecke eigenvalues (gap 0.0991 ≈ |q₀−1| vs Young ±1), so σᵢ maps to a NON-generator element of ℂ[S₅] — confirming the algebra-iso picture and the intertwiner_trace_eq obstruction (#4199). UPSHOT: the deformation half (Hecke→q=1 seminormal) is explicitly constructed and *-isometric; the residual to |c| is the pure-S₅ alignment U of the q=1 seminormal SYT basis to the Braden–Northover period basis (M_S), whose S₅ action is NOT in the corpus. No instance; 1/(8π) phase-4; nothing wired.

caveats: T(q) closes the DEFORMATION half (Hecke→q=1 seminormal), a valid *-compatible Tits conjugator. The geometric-realization half — the pure-S₅ intertwiner U from the q=1 seminormal SYT basis to the Braden–Northover period basis (M_S) — needs the S₅ action in that basis, which is NOT in the corpus. |c| stays gated on U.
